description: Source code for initializing and managing memory and setup for the Dynamic Bass Enhancement (LVDBE) module in an audio processing system.

methods.name: LVDBE_Memory
methods.description: Handles memory requirements and allocation for the LVDBE instance, providing size, alignment, and base address info.

methods.name: LVDBE_Init
methods.description: Creates and initializes an LVDBE instance, setting default parameters, filters, AGC, volume, and mixers.
